hooks.command: RR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; ENV_NAME=""; if [ -f "$RR/.env" ]; then ENV_NAME="$(grep -E '^SDK_CONDA_ENV=' "$RR/.env" | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"' | tr -d "'")"; fi; [ -z "$ENV_NAME" ] && ENV_NAME="${SDK_CONDA_ENV:-}"; [ -z "$ENV_NAME" ] && exit 0; jq -e --arg env "$ENV_NAME" 'select(.tool_input.command | test("(^|\\s)(python3?|pip3?)\\b")) | select(.tool_input.command | test("^conda |conda run") | not) | .tool_input.command as $cmd | {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","updatedInput":{"command":("conda run -n " + $env + " " + $cmd)}}}' || true
